## Mandatory fresh independent review

Task ID; reviewed base/target SHA; report path in reports/reviews; new reviewer session ID and enforced isolation evidence; recommendation; unresolved findings and founder P2 acceptance evidence; additional domain/security review when high-risk; coordinator verification.

No Done/merge until checks and acceptance pass. A reused review, self-approval, missing isolation or stale target means Review Blocked.
